subject: Commercial acceptance flow: timeline, owners & next actions
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Dana Cole <dana.cole@acmehealth.com>, AcmeHealth Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Commercial acceptance flow: timeline, owners & next actions

Hi Dana / Procurement team,

Great to connect earlier — thanks for walking through the use case and constraints. Per our call, below is a concise recap and a suggested timeline so we can align owners and unblock the path to a signed PO. Please flag anything that looks off and confirm the owners listed.

High-level procurement path (proposed gating & approximate durations):
- Legal review (Redlines + SOW): 10–14 business days — Owner: Acme Legal (please confirm contact)
- Security intake & evidence (questionnaire, SOC2, retention policy): 10–15 business days from security kickoff — Owner: Acme Security
- Finance/Procurement approval & PO issuance: 3–7 business days after approvals — Owner: Acme Finance/Procurement
- Go-live/Account activation: 1–2 business days after PO receipt and onboarding tasks completed

Marketplace vs PO vs Card: you mentioned PO is preferred for larger commitments; we can accept PO or card. AWS Marketplace is an option but usually adds ~1 week for procurement approvals and additional billing constraints — happy to outline trade-offs if helpful.

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Can you confirm primary contacts for Legal, Security, and Finance?
2) Will Acme pursue a direct PO or would you like us to pursue Marketplace registration in parallel?
3) Please review the attached Mutual Action Plan (MPA) and SLA summary; I’ve added a first-pass set of milestones — I can revise once you confirm owners.

Attachments: Redwood_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.pdf, SLA-summary.xlsx

If helpful, I can schedule a 30-min security intake with our applied-security lead and a short redlines session with our commercial counsel.

Thanks,

Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
From: Dana Cole <dana.cole@acmehealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: AcmeHealth Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 12:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commercial acceptance flow: timeline, owners & next actions

Ben — thanks for the clear recap. That aligns with how we run these. Quick answers and context from my side:

Estimated internal timeline (high level):
- Legal review (initial pass): 2 weeks (Owner: Paul Turner, paul.turner@acmehealth.com)
- Security intake & evidence collection: target 3 weeks (Owner: Maya Shah, maya.shah@acmehealth.com)
- Finance review & PO issuance: 3–5 business days after approvals (Procurement mailbox: procurement@acmehealth.com)

We’re leaning toward a direct PO for this engagement. Marketplace could be acceptable but prefer direct PO if possible — marketplace introduces extra procurement approvals for our Finance team.

Immediate asks from our side:
1) Please send a redline-friendly contract and the specific clauses we should expect to negotiate (IP/data, indemnity, termination).
2) A one-page evidence checklist for security (SOC2 scope, data retention, access controls, audit logs).
3) Proposed times for a security intake call next week.

I’ve attached a quick procurement timeline worksheet (Acme_Procurement_Timeline.xlsx) that shows how we stage reviews for third-party software. If you can provide the MPA link and the DocuSign contact, we’ll prioritize legal review once we have a contract to look at.

Thanks — Dana
Dana Cole
Head of Procurement | Acme Health
dana.cole@acmehealth.com | +1 (617) 444-8900

Attachment: Acme_Procurement_Timeline.xlsx
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Dana Cole <dana.cole@acmehealth.com>, AcmeHealth Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commercial acceptance flow: timeline, owners & next actions

Thanks Dana — really helpful. I’ve updated the MPA to reflect the owners and the staging you shared. Summary of updates I just pushed:

- Legal: Paul Turner (Acme) — milestone: draft review + initial redlines (target: 2027-07-05)
- Security: Maya Shah (Acme) — milestone: security intake complete + evidence delivery (target: 2027-07-12)
- Finance/PO: procurement@acmehealth.com — milestone: PO issued (target: 2027-07-15)

If Acme can confirm those dates as feasible, we’ll set calendar holds and begin the contract redline in parallel. I’ve also included a short evidence checklist below to accelerate Security:
- SOC2 Type II report (latest)
- Data retention policy & expected retention window for logs and user data
- Network architecture diagram (if a VPC/private deploy)
- Access control & IAM overview for any integration points
- Audit log retention and export process

Marketplace note: AWS Marketplace registration is an option; if you ask us to pursue it in parallel, expect ~7–10 additional days for registration and billing alignment. If time-to-first-call is critical, direct PO will be faster.

MPA link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-mpa
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deal/ACME-2027-338
DocuSign contact: legal@redwood.com (we’ll prepare a Docusign envelope once redlines are agreed)

I’m attaching the updated MPA export and SLA summary I referenced earlier. We can also share a redline-friendly contract PDF or a plain-text attachment — what does your legal team prefer?

Ben
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: Redwood_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.pdf, SLA-summary.xlsx

Subject: Internal: prioritization & legal/security owners for Acme Health (for calendar holds)

Ben / Marissa — quick internal note so we’re aligned before we push calendar invites to Acme:

- Legal: Redwood commercial counsel will prioritize Acme once Ben confirms the go-ahead. Point-of-contact: legal@redwood.com (we can route to counsel for redline session).
- Security intake: I’ll coordinate a 30–45 min intake between Acme Security (Maya Shah) and our Applied Security team (Maya Patel + SRE sec lead). Proposed time windows: Wed 2027-06-23 10:00-12:00 PT or Thu 2027-06-24 14:00-16:00 PT.
- Contract format: we should provide a redline-friendly Word doc and a plain-text clause list — that tends to speed legal review.

Marissa — can you prepare a short checklist for the security intake (evidence, sample questions, links to SOC2) and share draft calendar invites once Ben confirms the time with Acme?

Thanks — Lauren
Senior Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com

Ben / Lauren / team — all good here. We’ll prioritize legal review once you send the redline-friendly contract. Security intake sounds good — we can do Thu 2027-06-24 14:30 PT (Maya Shah will join).

On evidence: please include SOC2 scope, retention policy, and a short note on whether Redwood’s hosted offering stores identifiable PHI (if any) and the controls in place. That will help our security and legal teams prioritize.

I’ll have procurement@acmehealth.com start a funding hold and loop in Finance if we hit the expected dates.

Thanks — Dana
